svg.title: Remote Agent on a single host
svg.desc: An IoT Gateway already runs on the host. The agent is installed with one docker run command and keeps a two-way gRPC stream to ThingsBoard and a local link to the Docker Engine. It discovers the running Gateway. An Edge is added in the install wizard, which creates the Edge entity and its credentials. When Edge 4.4 is released, one click upgrades it: volumes are backed up, the database is migrated, and Edge 4.4 starts.

g.text: 1 · A Gateway already runs on the host. Install the agent with one command
2 · Two-way gRPC link to ThingsBoard, local link to the Docker Engine
3 · The running Gateway is discovered, no redeploy needed
4 · Add an Edge in the install wizard: entity and credentials included
5 · A new Edge version is released: upgrade in one click
6 · Upgrade with volume backup, database migration, auto-rollback
Template synced from GitHub · Upgrade available
